title: Screening tools
subtitle: Automatic scoring and cut-off interpretation according to official sources
disclaimerTitle: These are screening tools, not a diagnosis.
disclaimer: The result only shows whether a fuller assessment is worthwhile. A diagnosis of dependence is made by a physician or qualified specialist.

sexNote: Sex not stated – the more conservative male cut-off is used.

AUDIT.zone3: WHO: simple advice plus brief counselling and continued monitoring.
AUDIT.zone4: WHO: referral to a specialist for diagnostic evaluation and treatment.

AUDIT-C.negative: No indication for further assessment based on consumption.
AUDIT-C.positive: Consider the full AUDIT and a conversation about drinking.
AUDIT-C.high: Full AUDIT and a specialist consultation are advisable.

DUDIT.negative: Below the cut-off for sex (≥ 6 men, ≥ 2 women).
DUDIT.problems: Further assessment (e.g. DUDIT-E) and a motivational conversation are advisable.
DUDIT.dependence: Score ≥ 25 – a consultation at an addiction treatment clinic is advisable.
